segments.title: September
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! September is The Comeback, plus fifty-seven days to Diwali. Routines are back, festive photos are coming, and everyone suddenly remembers they wanted to feel great in October. We're here to help, with a deadline.

segments.title: ₹11.8L
segments.text: So, the number. Our September target for Kenkere House is 11.8 lakh rupees. That's 15 per cent up on last September. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 6.25 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 4.01 lakh, everything else 82,600, and comebacks 70,800. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 59 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 878 leads, 316 trials, and 59 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.

Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 7.57 lakh rupees, which is 64 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Glow-Up or Give Back
segments.text: First up, for newcomers, Glow-Up or Give Back. We measure on day one and again before the festive photos. Do thirty classes and don't improve? The third month is on us. Confidence, guaranteed. The plan is 5 buyers at about 24,800, so 1.24 lakh rupees.

segments.title: We Need to Talk
segments.text: Next, We Need to Talk. Not like that. Our studio managers personally call high-value lapsed members. Say yes, and get six months at twenty per cent off, unlimited freezes and a private to restart. The plan is 3 buyers at about 50,000, so 1.5 lakh rupees.

segments.title: New Phone, Who Dis?
segments.text: Then, for everyone else who drifted, New Phone, Who Dis? One free, no-questions-asked comeback class. Buy within seven days, and get fifteen per cent off plus an extra freeze. The plan is 10 buyers at about 12,400, so 1.24 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Lock It Before the Laddoos
segments.text: And finally, for renewals, Lock It Before the Laddoos. Renew for three months by the thirtieth: fifteen per cent off, a Diwali hamper, and unlimited freezes for festive travel. The plan is 10 buyers at about 35,900, so 3.59 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, newcomers measure day one and hear the glow-up guarantee. Week two, studio managers call our highest-value lapsed members. Week three, the seven-day comeback window opens for everyone else. Week four, every renewal is locked before the laddoos arrive.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's September at Kenkere House. 11.8 lakh rupees, four offers, and 59 buyers to welcome. Fifty-seven days. No pressure. Well, a little pressure.
